capability: Publish a generated report completely or not at all without exposing it first: every fallible step, including the pre-open hook, completes before the first report state change or notification
searchEvidence: PR #457 automatic review (P2) on src/NvtFwCombiner.Presentation.Avalonia/ViewModels/ReportPresentationViewModel.cs, tracked as docs/handoff/bugs/BUG-20260926-report-publish-notifies-before-fallible-open.md: with show true, PublishGeneratedReport inserts the history entry, raises the toast and sends the report property and collection notifications before ShowReport runs the fallible _beforeOpen() hook (MainWindowViewModel binds Replace.CloseSelectionForRun). The catch restores the fields and the collection, but observers have already seen the transient report: MainWindow queues report-history persistence on ReportHistoryCount and starts the toast timers on HasReportToast. The regression PostcommitReportPublicationFailureRestoresPreviousReport asserts that transient history count ([2, 1]) and checks only the last LoadedReport notification; GeneratedReportThatCannotOpenIsRolledBack checks only the final state.

rg -n 'PublishGeneratedReport|_beforeOpen|CaptureLoadedReportInHistory|ShowReport\(' src tests: ReportPresentationViewModel is the only generated-report publisher (CompositionRunPresentationViewModel.ShowDiagnosticPreviewAsync and ApplyRunResult call it). Its fallible steps are the Text provider reads for the toast, the history entry that CaptureLoadedReportInHistory creates, and ShowReport's CancelReportHistoryReopen and _beforeOpen; everything after them is field assignment, collection updates and notifications isolated by PresentationObserver.

CaptureLoadedReportInHistory (ReportPresentationViewModel.History.cs) is the only history retention rule (MaxReportHistoryEntries, MaximumReportHistoryStorageBytes), and ShowReport holds the only open sequence for an already loaded report (history reopen and the history view set the modal state in their own code). The publisher reuses both rather than duplicating them: the history capture splits into a side-effect-free entry creation and a commit, and ShowReport into its fallible preparation (the history-reopen cancellation and the pre-open hook) and a commit. F07-RESIDUALS-1113-01, which admitted the current catch-and-restore publication, is final at 1da2aa14a; no active record owns these paths.
semanticOwner: ReportPresentationViewModel remains the only owner of the loaded report, its JSON, the report history and its sequence, the report toast and the report modal. ShowReport's open sequence becomes the shared PrepareReportOpen and OpenLoadedReport helpers, which ShowReport and generated-report publication both call; history reopen and the history view keep their own open code. CaptureLoadedReportInHistory's retention rule remains the only history retention, shared through CreateReportHistoryEntry and AddReportHistoryEntry. CompositionRunPresentationViewModel, its failure handling and every call site are unchanged.
terminalContract: A generated-report publication is all-or-nothing for its own report (the outer report). It first completes every fallible step: the toast title and text; when it opens the report, the history-reopen cancellation and the pre-open hook; then the next history entry, created after the hook. Only then does it commit the outer report's loaded report, JSON, history entry, toast and open review in one pass of assignments and PresentationObserver-isolated notifications that cannot fail. A failure before that commit rethrows before the publication changes the loaded report, its JSON, the history or its sequence, the toast or the modal, and before it raises any report notification, so no observer sees the outer report. Effects that the cancellation or the hook cause on their own are not rolled back: a history reopen it cancelled stays cancelled, the Replace selection that the production hook closes stays closed, and a publication that the hook completes synchronously stays published with its own notifications; the outer report then takes the following history sequence, so sequences stay contiguous and unique and the outer report is the loaded one. Without such reentrancy, a successful publication reaches the same state with the same notifications in the same order as before; only the cancellation and the hook now run before the commit instead of after the report is notified. CaptureLoadedReportInHistory keeps its retention and notifications, but a failed history-entry construction (not reachable with a well-formed ReportReviewViewModel) no longer consumes a sequence number, in each of its callers (report file load, load error, run error report) and in generated publication; with show true that failure follows the pre-open hook and precedes every outer-report commit and notification. ShowReport keeps its behavior through the shared helpers; report file loads and error reports are otherwise unchanged, as are history reopen, the history view, output bytes, names and ranges.
